title: Botnet Analysis: A Product-Grade Threat for the AI Service Era
content: NadMesh is an industrial-grade Go-based botnet observed in July 2026 that autonomously scans and exploits AI infrastructure and cloud services. The botnet integrates scanning, exploitation, and intelligence harvesting into a single platform targeting over 90 cloud provider address ranges. title: GoSerpent backdoor attacks in Southeast Asia
content: Since late 2025, government and diplomatic entities in Southeast Asia have been targeted by sophisticated attacks involving GoSerpent, a Go-based RAT with proxy capabilities. The malware receives encrypted arguments and deploys additional tools for data collection and credential dumping. title: HelloNet campaign: a threat via the ViPNet update system
content: An active APT campaign discovered in May 2026 exploits the ViPNet update system to deploy previously unknown tooling against large Russian organizations. Attackers achieve persistence through DLL sideloading, placing malicious wtsapi32.dll in ViPNet directories. The campaign employs multiple components: HelloInjector loader, HelloProxy for traffic proxying and payload delivery, HelloExecutor... This pulse includes 11 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Government, Energy, Transportation. Associated malware: HelloInjector, HelloProxy, HelloExecutor.
